Theorem
[Berger's zero theorem]

Source: petersen:page-0335 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-norm-formulas ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-skew-symmetric 1. ch8:8.3.1If $(M,g)$ is a compact, even-dimensional manifold of positive sectional curvature, then every Killing field has a zero.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch8-berger-killing-field-zero \sketch Suppose $X$ is nowhere zero and minimize $f= frac 12|X|^2$ at $p$. Then $ abla f=- abla _XX=0$ by section 2, so $X_p$ belongs to the kernel of the skew-adjoint map $( abla X)_p$ from section 1. Because $T_pM$ is even-dimensional, this kernel has even dimension and contains a vector $v$ independent of $X_p$. The Hessian formula gives

\[ \operatorname {Hess}f(v,v)=-R(v,X,X,v)<0, \]

contradicting minimality.

□
